entries.eae0e42504006146: There are 3 reportable segments: the Gas Business, the Chemical Products Business and Other Businesses. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥72,797 million for the Gas Business, ¥21,694 million for the Chemical Products Business and ¥3,509 million for Other Businesses, with the Gas Business accounting for about 3/4 of the total. Revenue from external customers in Japan exceeds 90% of consolidated revenue, and there is no customer accounting for 10% or more of consolidated revenue. The environment surrounding the Gas Business shows a partial recovery trend for semiconductor applications, but demand recovery remains sluggish in destination industries such as steel, automobiles, construction and food, and raw material prices continue to stay high.
